Unseen Forces

Released August 1, 2005 · 145 cards

Unseen Forces is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on August 1, 2005. Its main set has 115 cards, plus 30 secret rares numbered beyond the set (145 in total). It includes 124 Pokémon, 16 Trainer and 5 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

29 illustrators worked on Unseen Forces. Most cards: Ryo Ueda (13), Shin-ichi Yoshikawa (13), Mitsuhiro Arita (11), Kyoko Koizumi (10), Nakaoka (10), Kagemaru Himeno (8), Masakazu Fukuda (8), Midori Harada (8).
